findings: `learner.overview` presents the competing explanations of 匘’s ancient construction as a side note before stating how 脑 works, leaving readers without a clear first-reading account. Lead with 脑 as the simplified form of 腦, then briefly say the traditional graph’s construction is disputed; retain 匘’s “head marrow” gloss in the deeper explanation. Cite the simplified-form and disputed-analysis evidence.
